data.item: Part 1 Item 5: Item 8 End-to-End Measurement and Breakdown

stageBreakdown.details: YouTube VTT fetching via yt-dlp/player API and word-level suffix-prefix overlap deduplication

14 translation units executed sequentially through Groq API with 0-temp JSON schema enforcement, rate-limit backoffs (1-2s pause per call), and token decoding (~13.9s per unit average including network roundtrip and rate limit pauses)
Groq API call generating 8-slide structured outline from deduped English chunks (~1,820 prompt tokens)
Groq API call generating detailed slide cards, bullets, and cited chunks (~2,480 prompt tokens)
Sequential yes/no grounding checks across 24 bullets against source Hindi transcript chunks via Groq (~2.9s per check including network latency and regeneration passes for ungrounded bullets)
pptxgenjs compilation of PowerPoint binary buffer and slide geometry layout
